title: Warm Buttery Peruvian Shrimp Chupe De Camarones
description: A buttery and silky Peruvian dish featuring shrimp in a rich semi-skimmed milk sauce, served in a lacquerware bowl. This plant-based friendly version uses vegan butter and is cooked to perfection in a papillote.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the semi-skimmed milk, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the milk mixture.
Place the shrimp mixture in a papillote and dot the top with vegan butter.
Fold the papillote to seal and place in a lacquerware bowl.
Bake for 12 minutes or until the shrimp are pink and cooked through.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve immediately in the lacquerware bowl.
